answer_1.quote: Therefore, this study fills the gap by 1) investigating vulnerabilities of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs to being misused for generation of personalized disinformation, 2) examining the quality of personalization, and 3) how it affects their integrated safety mechanisms.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation of linguistic quality, we use the GRUEN metric along with LLM-based (Gemma-2-27b-IT) meta-evaluation of Linguistic Acceptability and Output Content Quality, as defined by METAL.

answer_3.quote: The meta-evaluation of personalization is processed by three different LLMs of various sizes (GPT-4o of Ope-nAI, Gemma-2-27b-IT of Google, and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct of Meta providers) to minimize the effect of internal biases and self-assessment of the text-generation models.
methods: Four-point scale evaluation for personalization quality

answer_4.quote: Five human annotators (out of the authors) have rated the personalization quality of the carefully selected 109 texts on a fourpoint scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered 'How well does the fake news article address the intended audience?' on a four-point scale: 0 (not at all), 1 (low extent), 2 (illogical or forced), 3 (well personalized), with descriptions and examples.
